subject: Essential Mathematics
title: Real Numbers
coreCompetencies:
Critical thinking and Problem solving: the learner develops interpretation and inference skills as they classify numbers as either rational or irrational numbers.
Self-efficacy: the learner develops self-awareness as they discuss the use real numbers in real life such as in body temperature and blood pressure.
values:
Responsibility: the learner takes care of a calculator when using it to work out reciprocal of numbers.
Respect: the learner develops humility by taking turns while discussing with peers and working out combined operations.
pcis: Health promotion issues: the learner develops healthy practice skills while discussing use of real numbers in recording body temperature and blood pressure.

outcomes.text: classify real numbers as rational or irrational,
perform combined operations on rational numbers,
determine the reciprocal of real numbers using calculators,
apply rational numbers in real life situations,
appreciate the use of real numbers in real life.
